insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited

room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment applies to every admissible claim for all insured persons

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments at 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year (whichever lower); listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, HIFU, etc.) capped at 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable after 12 months continuous coverage

ped_waiting.note: Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, piles, calculi, hydrocele, etc.; 36-month list includes joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate on claim; alternatively insured may opt for No Claim Discount on premium instead

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; 24-hour hospitalisation limit not applicable for day-care

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expense cover in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: Listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intravitreal injections, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Gloves, masks, and many consumables explicitly listed as non-payable in Annexure A List I

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded; territorial limit is India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; includes portability/migration credits

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: IRDAI-mandated portability with continuity of waiting period credits

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary & OPD, maternity, overseas treatment, sterility/infertility, war, nuclear/bio/chemical, addiction treatment
